purpose: Make a first action a prerequisite for a later one.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Verb て-form + からでないと + negative result
You cannot enter until you have made a reservation.
I cannot decide until I have seen the actual item.
You must not use it until you have received permission.
formation: Verb て-form + からでないと + negative result
restrictions: The main clause normally denies possibility or acceptability before the prerequisite.
mistake: Do not use an affirmative result where the meaning requires cannot yet.
